caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of furniture, specifically a settee or loveseat, positioned against a plain, off-white background. The settee features an ornate wooden frame with a reddish-brown color and detailed carvings along the crest rail and legs. The backrest and seat are upholstered with vertically-striped fabric, alternating between muted gold, beige, blue, and green tones, and the cushioning is tufted with buttons. The backrest is high, curved, and has a scalloped shape with carved floral or scroll motifs at three prominent points along the top. The seat is wide, extending beyond the back on each side, and has a rounded, undulating front edge. The legs are short, curved, and feature additional carved embellishments, ending in small caster wheels. The name “Ralph M. Norton” is written in small script in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Love Seat
